purpose: Measure bounded post-holdout correction effort on every recorded baseline failure without changing baseline/parser/oracles.
procedure: Start an individual UTC and monotonic wall timer before inspecting each source case and its independent audit in this correction session.
Read retained source HTML, rendered context and expected observations; diagnose differences using existing metrics. Review original membership and fields, not merely copy a passing JSON result.

Record explicit sparse before/after field edits or inserted observations, source references, reason and unresolved questions. Use the existing independent oracle as correction assistance; this is not a blinded evaluation.
Apply the recorded edits to the saved first-run output. Stop timer after writing corrected artifact and comparing all five fields and complete record order to the unchanged audit.

Report each raw monotonic elapsed interval and minutes including inference/tool latency, with UTC bounds. Preparation, prior source familiarity, later documentation/CI and concurrent scheduling gaps are excluded. This is agent-assisted wall time, not active human minutes or billed model cost.

Publish unchanged initial metrics alongside corrected-document results and code-footprint/runtime/maintenance boundaries. Neither repaired results nor correction time measure untouched-source generalization.
success: Every edit is source-supported and replayable; exact equality may pass or fail and is reported. Any unresolved issue remains explicit. No new parser/framework/production dependency.
rights: Factual adapted observations from the retained CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative corpus; corpus/NOTICE.md source attribution and share-alike apply. No new network acquisition.
